name: Vector Cartoon
traits: smooth geometric curves with sharp tidy corners
flat fills with one hard shadow shape
suits: apps, digital services, household and food products; clear, upbeat, modern brands
stylePara: Vector cartoon: characters and sets built from clean geometric curves with crisp outlines of one uniform dark weight, sharp corners and tidy joins; flat solid fills from a controlled palette of eight to twelve colours, with one hard-edged shadow shape and one highlight shape per form; no texture, no grain, no gradients apart from one soft background gradient; rounded bendy limbs, big expressive eyes and simplified hands; backgrounds are layered flat shapes that slide with parallax; every shape looks drawn with clean curves, perfectly smooth.

rendering.line: uniform-weight dark outlines (or coloured lines a shade darker than the fill), perfectly smooth curves
rendering.shading: one hard-edged flat shadow shape and one highlight shape per form
rendering.colour: 8-12 flat colours with clear value separation between figure and ground; product colours exact
rendering.lighting: graphic: a consistent light side expressed by the shadow shapes, no light falloff

motion: Rigged cut-out or tweened animation: smooth body moves on ones with clean ease curves, mouth and hand swaps on twos; bendy limbs that curve without elbows; secondary motion on hair and leaves; shapes keep their crisp edges and outline weight while moving.
camera: Flat 2D camera: pans, trucks and zooms on the picture plane, with parallax between background layers; no 3D rotation of the set.
avoid: soft blurred edges and motion blur
random interface icons and text on screens
sheets: Characters as a flat turnaround (front, three-quarter, side) with the palette swatches and a mouth chart; places as one layered flat background with foreground, middle and back layers; the product as a flat vector icon with its exact silhouette and colours, the label simplified.
risk: Usually holds well, but Seedance adds depth: soft shading, motion blur and a 3D camera turn. Write 'flat 2D plane, no 3D camera rotation, no motion blur' in CAMERA and MOTION. Outlines wobble on fast action; keep moves moderate and clips 4-8 s.

example.prompt: Vector cartoon still: a woman in her thirties with big expressive eyes, a round dark bun and an orange top, drawn in smooth curves with uniform dark outlines, holds a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap in a sunny flat-coloured kitchen built from layered shapes; a droopy fern with rounded leaves sags on the windowsill; flat fills from a palette of ten colours, one hard shadow shape and one highlight per form, no texture, a soft yellow background gradient. Vertical 9:16. No text.
